text: The one breaking change this week is #13172 in BCApps: the old record-based GetLogEntryDetails method on Agent Task is removed, GetTaskLogEntryDetails overloads replace it, and AI Eval run data can be exported in structured form. Other behaviour changes are mostly fixes. In posting and finance, #13642 keeps work descriptions on prepayment documents, #13396 fixes partial purchase invoicing across receipts, #13547 and #13417 stop wrong sales order quantity updates after return orders, #13488 corrects ACY amounts when applying across posting groups, and #13336 fixes reminder creation when all entries are on hold. Localization fixes cover NL (#13630), Belgium (#13481, #13484), Switzerland (#13273, #13301) and French payment slips (#13472, #11596). Expense Agent received several fixes and additions, including #12985, #13185, #13460 and #13504. Sales Order Agent changes include #13599, #13469 and a move to GPT-5.6 in #13495, and #13506 does the same for three Copilot features. Quality Management gained #13427, #13560 and #13325. Smaller items include #13579 for the event record context, #13438 for cloud migration recovery and #9527, which removes internal access from E-Document Emailing. BCQuality changes are mainly guidance, such as #255 and #264.

issues: #13495 moves only the Sales Order Agent's auxiliary model calls to GPT-5.6. 'a move to GPT-5.6' could say this more precisely.
#9527 is not flagged as a behaviour change. It is listed under 'Smaller items', so the text holds up, but it comes straight after the behaviour-change lists.
The Quality Management items (#13427, #13560, #13325) are named without saying what they do. A short description of each would make the paragraph more useful.
